description: Build an original character brief grounded in Omoro styles. Returns an Omoro Characters-compatible JSON file and a detailed image prompt; it does not generate images or save anything to an account. Import the JSON at omoro.io/characters to keep editing there.

appearance_notes.description: Distinctive physical features and overall presence.

concept.description: The character idea, personality, story or brief. Include what makes them distinct.

hairstyle.description: Optional signature hairstyle. Describe the exact silhouette and unusual construction, such as sculptural coils arranged as a crown, braided loops, asymmetry, or an unexpected shape. Make it personal to this character.

kind.description: Choose creature for a non-human or hybrid design.

output.description: A single portrait or four-view reference sheet.

palette.description: Optional exact client colors. Otherwise the documented Omoro style palette is used.

role.description: Their role or place in the story.

signature_item.description: A memorable accessory or visual identifier.

species.description: Species or ancestry, especially for original creatures and hybrids.

style_slugs.description: One or two Omoro style slugs, with the lead style first. Find styles with search_styles or list_styles.

name: build_character
